root_cause: Required proved the complete Netlify production build before merge, but production deployment rebuilt the same source tree again. The build command was also duplicated across Netlify production, deploy-preview and Required, so optimization and ordering drifted independently.
prevention: Use one canonical measured build runner, cache its exact source-tree output, publish that output as a short-lived immutable GitHub artifact, and allow production to reuse it only when a successful Required run and the current main tree SHA match exactly. Production executes only release-identity stamping before provider packaging; any mismatch falls back to the canonical source build.
